decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-def6cbfde489] says what changed: the "5d" example was taken out of the refreshInterval documentation because it was a typo. Go's time.Duration parser has never supported days, so the doc listed a value that never worked; the product's behaviour did not change. The changed files [ev-1b40e7c79d7c] show that the edit covers the v1beta1 ExternalSecret Go type comment and the generated ExternalSecret and ClusterExternalSecret CRDs/bundle, as well as docs/api/spec.md. That identifies the subject: the refreshInterval field description on those kinds. The change is a description-only correction with no change to schema, validation or runtime, so no environment is newly exposed. The proposals were wrong to treat the one-line release note [ev-ad7162c77c9e] as the only evidence.
